name: SlaServiceCreditCalculator
tagline: Monthly circuit availability, tiered service credits and the credit claim workflow in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete B2B service-assurance app for telecom operators: it turns outage records into availability per enterprise circuit and month, merges overlapping outages, applies contract exclusions, picks the credit tier, caps it against the monthly recurring charge and runs the claim from raise to review, approval and the bill – with a step-by-step calculator and a what-if tool. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Availability per circuit per month with overlap merge and month-boundary split
Contract exclusions, minimum outage length and default SLA target
Tiered service credits by shortfall below target with a cap on MRC
Downtime budget and budget left per circuit, 6-month heat strip, chronic-circuit flag
Claim board with claim window, cap check, reasons, bill references and drag and drop
Log / edit outages with validation and a live credit preview
Bulk exclude, count again, set cause, CSV export, undo
KPI outputs and Power Fx events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
Designed phone layout, keyboard operation and ARIA labels
controlType: standard (2 controls: SlaServiceCreditCalculator data-set + SlaServiceCreditCalculatorPortal Power Pages)
